LESSON: CALMING THE STORM

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Miracles of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.2: Calming the Storm
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 7

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Calming the Storm, part of Miracles of Jesus Christ in Grade 8 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How does the miracle of calming the storm relate to challenges facing people today?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Calming the Storm together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and Imagination: The skill of making connections is enhanced as learners role-play a challenging situation

affecting young people today.

• Self-efficacy: The skill of self-awareness is demonstrated as learners discuss instances they faced challenging situations and

how they overcame.

Values:
• Integrity: The learners write a personal journal on how they depend on God in their daily lives

• Unity: The learners work together to complete different tasks/assignments.

Link to other subjects:

• Creative Arts and Sports: The learners role-play or compose and sing a song on overcoming the storms of life.

• Pre-technical Studies: The learners watch a movie on the miracle of calming the storm.
